name: Abhimanyu Saklani
title: AI / ML Engineer & Data Scientist
hero_summary: I build machine learning systems that turn messy, real-world data into measurable outcomes — from cutting Spark job runtimes by up to 72% to predicting cardiovascular risk across 68,000 patient records.
about_narrative: I'm a Computer Science undergraduate at NMIT Bengaluru, currently completing a Software Developer Trainee apprenticeship at Commonwealth Bank of Australia under the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme, where I'm getting hands-on exposure to enterprise software development practices.

My work sits at the intersection of machine learning and applied engineering: I like problems where a model's output has to survive contact with real infrastructure — job schedulers, clinical datasets, unstructured document corpora — not just a notebook. Recent projects have focused on ML-driven systems optimization, predictive healthcare analytics, and retrieval-augmented generation for document QA.

Coursework in AI & Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Data Mining, Big Data Technologies, and Database Management Systems backs the practical side, and I keep building outside the classroom — most recently placing 1st in the Sustainability Track at Vibe-a-thon and 2nd at NMIT's CRYPTEC Coding Battle 2025.
